tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation refuted the previously chosen barrier-siphon fit, so I am not repeating that fixed branch. The available data exhibit strong sink-gradient suppression and saturating dependence on u_now, consistent with the archived static siphon candidates. Fit the candidate parameters numerically and let confirmation determine whether this alternative meets tolerance.
